name: cobol-reserved-words-spec-named-only
body: Dialect::is_reserved encodes only the reserved words the COBOL SPEC names: cobol85 reserves CLASS and ALTER, ibm reserves ENTRY and ALTER, and cobol2002 and cobol2014 reserve nothing beyond the contextual OO-word rule. Limit: no full per-dialect reserved-word list is sourced (SPEC §19.4, §19.6), so a word another dialect reserves still parses as an ordinary name. Upgrade when a sourced per-dialect list exists, written from the GnuCOBOL manual and never copied from its GPL config.
